17:18 Local Time, 15:18 GMT, 20:48 IST: Gerhard Erasmus with a performance he won't forget in a hurry. Made 156 with the bat and then when the Moondra and Hoey threatened to pull off an unlikely heist, he takes 2 in the same over to end the game. Ireland started off steadily with a 54-run stand but a collapse saw them slip from 98-1 to 125/5. When Stirling fell as the 5th wicket, it looked like an easy win for Namibia but Dockrell and Campher rebuilt with a nice stand of 85. And then Moondra and Hoey added 58 in quick time to bring down the equation to 34 off 18. Erasmus brought himself on and ended things. Earlier Brassell was impressive as he took a four-fer with some key scalps in them. The series is level 1-1 with three matches to go. Stay tuned for the post-match stuff....

Gerhard Erasmus | Player of the Match and Namibia captain 1/4: [On Namibia's batting performance and building a strong foundation through a big partnership with his partner] Yeah, I thought we obviously set up a very good foundation with a big partnership between myself and Frylinck. We set up a good foundation, I believe, and when it was time to go, we managed to really score big at the back end. [On Frylinck's contribution in supporting his innings and helping the team build momentum] Yeah, awesome. He obviously had to go in quite early and sort of steady the ship after the first wicket fell. Yeah, so he's been in red-hot form and he batted really well, and same with Loftie-Eaton and the other guys chipping in towards the back end. But, yeah, we know this ground very well, and we know that we can make it tough to defend at the back end of the innings, if - and that's what I tried to do.

Erasmus 4/4: [On achieving his career-best performance and scoring his first ODI hundred against a Full Member nation, Ireland] Yeah, it feels like all my firsts are against Ireland. This is my first ODI hundred against a Full Member, obviously against Ireland. My debut 16 years ago, in 2011, was against Ireland. It's always special to play them. From the years of Porterfield and Joyce, who are now coaches - they were playing and now they're coaches - I feel like one of the old guys. So, yeah, it's probably my time to score my runs now as a senior statesman of the team. I always really enjoy my battles against them, and I've got very, very good friends amongst others from playing in leagues as well with the Irish boys.

A captain's performance from Gerhard Erasmus has helped Namibia level the series with three games to go. The next game is on the 27th of this month. We will be there nice and early for that one. Do join us then. For now it's bye bye from all of us here.
